data: This course is a deep dive into the reading and practice of poetry. What is a poem? How is it fashioned? What makes it such a powerful form of literary enchantment? This course explores the building blocks of poetry, interspersed with readings of poems from around the world – canonical and less familiar. As it delves into questions around the role of sound and metaphor, free verse and fixed form, inspiration and craft, it will examine how we might become better practitioners, as well as better listeners. The course will combine immersive practice sessions with readings, group discussions with one-on-one interactions. In addition to multiple writing and reading exercises, students will turn in a final assignment that includes six rigorously-workshopped poem drafts and one poem review.
